title: How skills and agents work in AWS Quick
original_title: How skills and agents work in AWS Quick
summary: Repeatable tasks like status updates, release notes, and ticket creation can be encoded in AWS Quick through agents and skills. This post covers how agents, skills, and your data fit together in AWS…
title_zh: AWS 介绍 Quick 中技能与智能体的用法
lead_zh: AWS 发文介绍如何在 AWS Quick 中用智能体和技能来编码状态更新、发布说明和工单创建等可重复任务，并说明它们与数据如何配合。
